prompt: A hooded black-robed inquisitor in tattered dark grey cloth looms over a kneeling captive, gripping the captive's wrist and tearing a folded parchment letter from his trembling fingers. The captive, in plain greyish drained but still human flesh, recoils, mouth open in fear. The inquisitor's free hand glows with sickly green coercive magic. The only source of light is a single guttering torch on a dungeon wall. The background is a cramped stone dungeon interior in deep shadow.

Close-up of a skeletal black gauntleted hand plunging into the chest of a terrified man and drawing out a single glowing card-shaped fragment of memory, wine-purple light leaking from the wound where the secret is being pulled free. The man's greyish drained but still human face is contorted in pain. The only light source is the violet glow of the extracted secret. The background is a dark swamp at night, gnarled black trees.

A frightened robed scholar holds a fan of parchment cards close to his chest while a long clawed shadowy black hand reaches in from the right and snatches one card away. The stolen card glows pale green as it is torn from the fan. The scholar's greyish drained but still human face turns away in alarm. The only source of light is a candle on a desk. The background is a dim study with bookshelves in deep shadow.

Two figures fully visible in a dark swamp. On the left a black-robed witch thrusts out a hand casting sickly green coercive magic. On the right a robed victim, greyish drained but still human, staggers as parchment cards are ripped from his hands and scatter into the air, one card dissolving into green ash. The only light source is the green spell glow. The background is a misty black swamp with dead trees.

Extreme close-up of a human hand holding a fan of three parchment cards, while a bony black clawed hand reaches in and pinches one single card to pull it free. The pulled card glows pale green at its torn edge. The other two cards stay in the fan. The only source of light is the green glow of the stolen card. The background is deep black shadow with faint stone wall texture.

A tall hooded interrogator in tattered black robes grips a kneeling prisoner by the collar and rips a glowing folded letter out of the prisoner's clenched fist. The prisoner, greyish drained but still human flesh, is wide-eyed and cowering, both hands grabbing for the letter being taken. The only source of light is a single torch mounted on the dungeon wall behind them, casting long shadows. The background is a grim stone dungeon.

A hooded interrogator in tattered black robes on the right leans over a cowering kneeling prisoner on the left and pulls a single glowing parchment scroll away from the prisoner's grasping hands. The prisoner is greyish drained but still human flesh, wide-eyed. The glowing scroll stretched between their hands is the brightest thing in the frame. The only source of light is a torch on the dungeon wall. The background is grim warm stone dungeon brickwork.

Wide shot of two robed figures in a black swamp at night. On the left a black-cloaked sorcerer flings out both hands unleashing a burst of sickly green coercive magic. On the right a robed victim staggers backward, greyish drained but still human, his fan of parchment cards blown apart and scattering into glowing green motes. The only light source is the green spell burst at the center. The background is foggy dead black trees and still water.
